descriptions.text: Our Basic Black 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) Cardstock is great for handmade cards and other paper crafts. It's high quality, acid free, and lignin free, making it a favorite scrapbook paper too. This classic, heavyweight cardstock is dyed with pure color all the way through, so you won't see any white edges when you cut or tear it (except with our white cardstock). The ultrasmooth surface makes it an ideal paper for stamping, giving you clean, crisp images.
